overloadMerges.note: selector's 10 recognized option constants are given explicit sentinelValues (the leading pair and every repeated pair share the same selector domain); direction was already correctly 'in' for value here (SET, unlike GET, takes value as input).

params.name: ref
params.description: XML root element reference or reference of an open (SAX) document

params.name: selector
params.description: Option to set; a constant of the XML theme

params.name: value
params.description: New value of the option, as a constant of the XML theme

members.name: selector
members.description: Another option to set, same domain as the leading selector

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets one or more XML options (identified by selector constants) for a DOM root element or an open SAX document.

constraints: Applies to XML structures of the DOM ('tree') or SAX ('document') type.

The value-conversion options (e.g. binary/date/time/picture/string encoding, indentation, line ending) only affect the 4D-to-XML write direction used by commands such as DOM SET XML ATTRIBUTE, DOM SET XML ELEMENT VALUE, and SAX ADD XML ELEMENT VALUE; they have no effect on reading XML values into 4D.
You may pass as many selector/value pairs as needed in a single call.
